verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a privacy posture: per-user isolated cloud machines, separate data for each household member, and ZDR (zero-data-retention) model routing mentioned in llms.txt. None of it documents user-facing controls for setting retention periods or deleting stored data, memory, or the account. ZDR routing is a vendor-side policy on model providers, not a control the user can exercise, so the story is unevidenced.
